_comment: Optional. Orthanc serves this next to the portal at /pmc/. Every key is optional and overrides a built-in default. No credentials belong in this file: the portal is same-origin with the archive and never handles a password.
_ohif: OHIF's route follows the plugin's OHIF.DataSource. dicom-web (what PMC-ORTHANC01 is set to) needs 'ohif/viewer?StudyInstanceUIDs={studyUid}'; dicom-json needs 'ohif/viewer/dicomjson?url=../studies/{orthancId}/ohif-dicom-json'.
